summary: Restore MartechKit build and tests on iOS 27
description:
Get martech-kit compiling and its test suite green against the iOS 27 SDK.

This story was 'Support iOS 27' - the whole problem in one line, parented to nothing. It is now the first story of MTSDK-58 and scoped to exactly one outcome: the build goes green.

RevenueCat is named as the failure. Treat it as the first domino, not the whole list. Package.swift pins seven vendor SDKs at exact versions - RevenueCat 5.59.2, Amplitude 1.17.5, AppsFlyer 6.17.9, Firebase 12.11.0, Meta 18.0.3, TikTok 1.6.0, Superwall 4.14.2 - and none has been resolved against iOS 27. Package.swift already carries comments recording that two of them broke on Xcode 26. Expect more of the same, and budget for the ones with no compatible release rather than assuming a version bump exists.

Validate with xcodebuild against an iOS 27 simulator, not swift build. The README is explicit that plain swift build on macOS does not resolve the UIKit-dependent SDKs, so a green swift build here proves nothing.

Acceptance criteria:
- xcodebuild succeeds for every scheme (MartechKit, MartechKitMeta, MartechKitTikTok, MartechKitSuperwall, MartechKitFirebase) against an iOS 27 simulator
- All 16 test files pass on iOS 27
- codemagic.yaml builds against iOS 27 and the Xcode pin is updated and stated
- Package.resolved is committed and every vendor bump is named in the changelog
- No new Swift 6 concurrency warnings are introduced
- Any vendor SDK with no iOS 27-compatible release is filed with its blast radius, not worked around silently
